legacy_root.title: Standards and working-group archives as a first-class source class
legacy_root.question: For IETF datatracker, W3C group archives, OpenSSF/SLSA working groups and the MCP specification repository: what is the stable, machine-readable way to extract a normative requirement plus its discussion history, and which of our planned contracts already contradict a published normative requirement?
legacy_root.answer: IETF: RFC Editor JSON + datatracker doc.json/API + RFC body; history via rev_history and relateddocument. W3C: Specref JSON + api.w3.org specifications + Process bikeshed (em.rfc2119); history via Specref/GitHub/lists.w3.org. OpenSSF/SLSA: slsa.dev HTML (GitHub v1.0 markdown path 404s) plus in-toto provenance JSON; history via slsa-framework/slsa. MCP: specification MDX + generated JSON Schema / schema.ts SSOT; history via GitHub commits and discussions. Planned Phase-4 contract scan: 0 encoded-rule hits of 20 contracts. Negative control silent; mutant fires.

- Unlike base JSON-RPC, the ID MUST NOT be `null`.
MCP implementations MAY support sending JSON-RPC batches, but MUST support receiving JSON-RPC batches.
- Messages are delimited by newlines, and MUST NOT contain embedded newlines.
JSON-RPC messages MUST be UTF-8 encoded.

The SLSA Build level describes the overall provenance integrity according to minimum requirements on its: Completeness: What information is contained in the provenance? Authenticity: How strongly can the provenance be tied back to the builder? Accuracy: How resistant is the provenance generation to tampering within the build process? Requirement Description L1 L2 L3 Provenance Exists The build process MUST generate provenance that unambiguously identifies the output package by cryptographic digest and describes how that package was produced.

claims.statement: Over the 20 Phase-4 planned contracts in command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json (output_path under command-center/phase4/contracts/), the named polarity-inversion rules against pinned published MUST/MUST NOT sentences returned 0 hit(s). No catalog contract prose currently inverts the pinned MCP initialize-first, null-id, receive-batch, stdio-newline, RFC 8174 uppercase-only, or SLSA L2 authentic-provenance requirements.
claims.independent_verification: Signal 1: contradiction.evaluate() production scan of catalog question_or_target + tests_required. Signal 2: probe2 mutant control fires the same rules on an inverting clause, so a zero production count is not an always-silent detector.
claims.caveat: Contracts are still catalog prose, not authored phase4/contracts/*.json bodies.
